source.title: Hinterlands Mission VI: Moonkin Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Valori there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Valori in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at the underground lake in Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
